mentions.name: Go and SDL2 game engine
mentions.description: A hobby "game engine" written in Go and SDL2, built for fun. It is coming along nicely and has taught the author new concepts such as ECS in Go.
mentions.source_excerpt: Last but not least, I'm working on a "game engine" written in Go and SDL2. I do this for fun, but it is coming along nicely and teached me a few new concepts already (like ECS in Go).
